lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone comedy episode: a car flipper doubles prices for Black Friday and gets outsmarted by an accountant with a bot. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Lines: 1 loud showman sales pitch; 2 sly whisper, proud of the trick; 3 nervous excuse; 4 pleading; 5 panicked shout; 6 tired, resigned.

marina.profile: Marina — a precise, calm, ironic Russian accountant in her 30s, glasses; polite, dry, very clear diction.
marina.notes: Lines: 1 polite, businesslike; 2 calm verdict, slightly ironic; 3 matter-of-fact, confident; 4 calm punchline, a little smile.
